variants.name: single
findings: Fixed: Back only, Active shows the picked value, demo relabelled Cause

variants.name: multi
findings: Filter keeps "n selected"; Back / Done · n per the verb law

variants.name: cascade
findings: Fixed: Back is the secondary pickerFooter Back; trigger path "Antibiotics › Antibiotic B"; reopening opens All › Antibiotics with Antibiotic B ticked
New: the picker footer has no side gutter (Back 390 wide, edge to edge, corners cut)
Not fixed: atlas cascade demo labels Medicine but browses Symptoms

variants.name: cascade-multi
findings: Fixed: Record health with 4 conditions shows two clamped lines of names plus an unclamped "+1" inside the 65px trigger
New: Select conditions footer Back / Done · 4 run to the screen edges (no gutter)

findings.text: .st-picker-footer{padding:var(--space-12) 0} overrides .sheet-footer's side padding, so on Select conditions (Back / Done · 4) and Select medicine (Back, 390px wide) the buttons touch the screen edges and their rounded corners are cut. Moving the medicine sheet onto pickerFooter spread it.
findings.fix: bundle.css: .st-picker-footer{padding-block:var(--space-12)} (no inline 0) so the sheet footer keeps its gutter.

findings.text: Atlas cascade variant demo labels the field Medicine but browses Symptoms, with path [Antibiotics, Conditions] (round 3, not fixed).
findings.fix: variants/cascade.html: use medicine categories and a medicine leaf.

findings.text: Overview demos Conditions as "1 selected" while record forms show names (round 3, not fixed).

verdicts.finding: Medicine Back drawn as filled primary
verdicts.note: pickerFooter({multi:false}) gives a secondary Back; but no gutter (new finding)

verdicts.finding: Path joined with " / " on the trigger
verdicts.note: " › " on trigger, search meta and group titles

verdicts.finding: Reopen starts at All with nothing marked
verdicts.note: Opens at the category with the current medicine ticked

verdicts.finding: Overview "1 selected"; cascade demo browses Symptoms under Medicine

findings: Record-form names are line-clamped after "+n" is appended, so with long names the "+n" is the part that gets cut (Record health, 4 conditions: "Weakness or unsteady stance · Reduced appetite · Porcine reproductive and…").
Medicine picker's sole Back is still drawn as the full-width filled primary button; everywhere else Back is secondary (round-2 finding, not fixed).
Path written two ways: trigger "Antibiotics / Antibiotic B", sheet "All › Antibiotics".
Reopening the medicine picker starts at All with nothing marked, so the current pick is not shown.
Atlas Overview demos Conditions (a record form) as "1 selected", and the cascade demo browses Symptoms under a Medicine label.
